settings.title: Scheduled scans
settings.subtitle: AI agents file ideas and concerns as they work. This is for periodic scans that run on a separate schedule.

innovation.label: Innovation session
innovation.desc: Analyzes completed tasks and existing features to generate new value ideas, adding them to the idea box.

vuln_scan.label: Vulnerability & bug scan
vuln_scan.desc: AI reviews each theme's recent code changes for bugs and security concerns and files them to the concern backlog (known dependency vulnerabilities are also checked with bun audit).

health_check.label: Log health check
health_check.desc: Extracts warnings/errors from that day's backend logs and files them to the concern backlog, grouped by type.

loop_review.label: Quality loop review
loop_review.desc: Compares weekly workflow bounce metrics (critic gate, verify repair, CI repair) and auto-files a concern for every bucket that is not improving.

ci_watch.label: CI watch (mainline)
ci_watch.desc: Checks each project's latest mainline CI runs and auto-files a concern (with failing job/step names) for every red workflow - the guardian that keeps mainline CI from rotting, separate from the PR-level CI repair loop.

daily_report.label: Daily report
daily_report.desc: Consolidates the last 24 hours of autonomous activity (completed tasks, merged PRs, concerns, learnings, decisions, self-restarts, human interventions, upcoming queue) into one morning notification, archived at /agents/daily-report.

miss_ledger.label: Miss learning
miss_ledger.desc: Records defects that slipped past the quality gates (CI bounces, post-completion concerns) with evidence, and generates detection-cue suggestions reviewed at /agents/miss-signatures.

settings.noticeInnovation: Started. Generated ideas will appear in the idea box.
settings.noticeOther: Started. Detected concerns will appear in the concern backlog.

projectOverrides.title: Per-project settings
projectOverrides.subtitle: Only applies to projects (themes) with a working directory set. Toggle each job on/off per project. The log health check only targets a project once you set its log directory and format. Scheduling (frequency/time) follows the shared settings above.
projectOverrides.noThemes: No projects have a working directory set. Set a working directory on a theme to configure it here.
projectOverrides.logDirPlaceholder: Enter or browse for the log output directory
projectOverrides.updateFailed: Failed to update the project setting
